usage: The word '炒粉絲' is a noun referring to a specific dish made by stir-frying vermicelli noodles.
'炒粉絲' can be used when ordering food at a restaurant or talking about favorite dishes.
It often appears in menus under vegetable or noodle dishes, emphasizing the cooking method (stir-fried) and the ingredient (vermicelli).
When using '炒粉絲', you can describe different variations by adding adjectives or additional ingredients.
It's common to hear people say '我想食炒粉絲' (I want to eat stir-fried vermicelli) to express a craving or choice.
